# AstrBot QQ mention fixtures

`astrbot_qq_mentions.json` contains outputs generated by executing the official
`AiocqhttpAdapter._convert_handle_message_event` and `CommandFilter` methods
against an offline OneBot payload and member-info API double. No QQ connection
or network access is needed to replay the regression test.

The inputs cover a normal nickname, a nickname containing spaces, and a bot wake
mention followed by a member nickname containing parentheses and a symbol.
Each was generated with v4.16.0, v4.27.2 and the pinned current revision recorded
in `source_ref`. `native_args` preserves the actual command parser result,
including truncated nicknames when an optional argument has a string default.

Official source paths:

- [QQ adapter](https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/blob/e99432c8766e23b6090b38b0064d843271513855/astrbot/core/platform/sources/aiocqhttp/aiocqhttp_platform_adapter.py)
- [Command parser](https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/blob/e99432c8766e23b6090b38b0064d843271513855/astrbot/core/star/filter/command.py)
